title: Chevening UK Government Master's Scholarships
eligibility: International students with an undergraduate degree and at least 2 years of work experience
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly living stipend, flights)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification
description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in any subject at any UK university.

title: Google STEP Internship 2025
eligibility: First or second-year undergraduate students majoring in Computer Science or related STEM fields
qualification: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree program in CS or related technical major
description: STEP (Student Training in Engineering Program) is a 12-week developmental internship for undergraduate students with a passion for computer science and software engineering.

title: Software Development Engineer I (SDE 1)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of software engineering experience
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
description: Design, develop, and maintain core services and features across Amazon's ecosystem using Java, C++, Python, and AWS cloud tools.

title: Associate Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Entry to early-career developers proficient in JavaScript, Vue.js or React, and modern web application development
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and version control using Git
description: Work remotely with a globally distributed team to build user interface components, optimize accessibility, and enhance user experience on GitLab's main DevOps platform.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an interest in learning programming
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Global Student Contest
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university
salary: Up to $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits & Mentorship
qualification: Enrolled student status at an accredited institution
description: The Imagine Cup gives students the opportunity to bring their original technology and AI-driven solutions to life using Microsoft Azure tools.
